experiences.name: Annapurna Base Camp Trek
experiences.description: Embark on the iconic multi-day trek to Annapurna Base Camp at 4,130m. Trek through rhododendron forests, terraced fields, and dramatic mountain landscapes with breathtaking views of Annapurna I, Machapuchare, and Hiunchuli. The trail passes through traditional Gurung villages offering authentic cultural immersion alongside stunning natural scenery.

experiences.name: Poon Hill Sunrise Viewpoint Hike
experiences.description: Rise before dawn and hike to Poon Hill at 3,210m for one of the most celebrated panoramic sunrise views in the Himalayas. Watch golden light illuminate the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges including over 20 peaks above 6,000m. The short but rewarding hike from Ghorepani takes approximately 45 minutes and is accessible for most fitness levels.

experiences.name: Gurung Village Cultural Homestay Experience
experiences.description: Stay overnight in a traditional Gurung family home in the village of Ghandruk, one of the largest Gurung settlements in Nepal. Share home-cooked dal bhat, learn about indigenous Gurung customs, explore the local Gurung Museum, and witness traditional dance performances. This immersive experience provides deep insight into the mountain communities that have thrived in the Annapurna region for centuries.

experiences.name: Mardi Himal Trek and High Camp Exploration
experiences.description: Trek the less-crowded Mardi Himal trail to High Camp at 4,500m for extraordinary close-up views of Machapuchare (Fishtail Mountain) and the Annapurna massif. This off-the-beaten-path route winds through dense forests teeming with wildlife including Himalayan tahr and red pandas, offering a more solitary and raw trekking experience compared to the main circuit routes.
experiences.location: Mardi Himal, Eastern Annapurna Conservation Area

experiences.name: Pokhara Lakeside Nature and Paragliding Base
experiences.description: Use Pokhara as your gateway hub and explore the natural wonders surrounding Phewa Lake including Davis Falls, Gupteshwor Cave, and the World Peace Pagoda with its stunning Himalayan backdrop. Enjoy fresh Nepali cuisine at lakeside restaurants, visit the International Mountain Museum to understand Himalayan ecology and trekking history, and take a peaceful rowboat ride on Phewa Lake at sunset.
